text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #897132

g.text: Earliest allowed start R
Wait for inputs, previous work and policy.
Having a free GPU is not enough.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #897132

g.text: First response time
Choose a boundary after readiness and
reserve: P = t_cap + N_wait times tau.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #897132

g.text: Turn waiting rules
Grace: accept late taps for 100 ms.
Transition: one bar before response.
Timeout: limit on waiting for remote audio.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #897132

g.text: WHY ONE GROUP?
A smaller unit helps only if inputs, generation, delivery and commitment support that unit.
The current writer produces whole bars even though syllables are placed on ticks and audio on samples.

g.text: Model response

after capture, not only replay bars.
